scope: Code quality and common contributor/agent standards; remaining Milestone 2 wiring is tabled. macOS qualification only.
source_note: Compiled/runtime checks exercised the source consolidated into compiled_behavior_revision. The later implementation revision adds only shared launcher/doctor validation and editor/documentation alignment, covered by 19 launcher tests and the 76-test common quality run. The evidence commit changes documentation only.

findings.resolution: One canonical coding standard and cumulative check matrix; explicit worker briefs, temporary file scopes, shared feature ownership, evidence rules and macOS priority.
Explicit Ruff and editor settings; quality command checks repository contracts, staged/unstaged diff whitespace and nonempty Python suite. Missing tools and failed checks fail the aggregate.
Reuse process-group cleanup; keep partial timeout diagnostics and failure receipts. A timeout cannot satisfy an expected-failure detector.

Reject symlinks, non-directories, wrong owner and non-0700 modes without chmod or repurposing existing data; create missing default privately. Doctor uses the same validation without creating or repairing the directory and distinguishes an absent default from an unsafe existing path.
Validate every key chord; retain valid entries and default fallback. Settings accepts one chord. Workspace shortcuts respect the Appearance modal.
After handling each frame, stop if client identity changed, detached or stopped; error reporting requires the captured owner. Baseline null-socket crash reproduced and fixed.

review_dispositions: Separate CCR workers reviewed guidance, tooling, desktop, and session/resource code; coordinator inspected patches and integrated tests.
Retracted history queue-bound, byte-accounting, and public/private-header findings after checking actual code; no speculative fixes applied.
Deferred optional layout-cycle, pane-visibility refactoring and new features; retained the existing four layouts, six themes and three densities.
Worker-generated history tests initially had incorrect framing and insufficient pressure. Coordinator corrected the test and proved baseline failure plus fixed normal and sanitizer recovery.

Final independent CCR review found doctor/launch runtime validation mismatch; fixed with shared validation and observed symlink, wrong-owner, special-mode, valid and absent-directory tests. No other concrete finding remained.
routing_note: Worker receipts and local CCR routing records identify zai,glm-5.3. This does not independently attest remote model weights.
verification_notes: GUI workloads ran serially. Independent private service checks and build directories ran concurrently.
The common quality command also passed when invoked by absolute path from /tmp.
Default UI capture visually inspected; all eight UI capture/rejection checks passed.
Native probe passed all 18 cases and restored keyboard source and clipboard; no physical-input check required.
Initial integration exposed formatting and compile errors; corrected before passing full checks. Logs retained in ignored build/quality/.
No runtime dependency or lockfile changes. No new dependency clearance or Linux UI qualification claimed.
Existing user service and unrelated worktrees were preserved. No PR opened or merge performed for this maintenance task.
QML style remains a manual review convention; no QML formatter/linter gate is claimed. This is a scoped audit, not proof that all future defects are absent.
